import hashlib
import json

import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from loguru import logger
from Tests.Workspaces.test_project_index_service import Rig
from tldw_chatbook.DB.Workspace_Project_Index_DB import prepare_scan_page
from tldw_chatbook.Workspaces.project_index.lifetime import BindingLifetime
from tldw_chatbook.Workspaces.project_index.models import FileCapture, ScanEntry, ScanPage, ProjectIndexSearchAuthority

@pytest.mark.bootstrap_profile
@pytest.mark.timeout(900)
async def test_cache_only():
    logger.disable("tldw_chatbook.Chunking")
    artifact = Path(".superpowers/sdd/2026-10-20-workspace-project-keyword-index/native-temp/k4-lexical-cache-only").resolve()
    artifact.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    rig = Rig(artifact)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    prepare_seconds = commit_seconds = 0.0
    try:
        status = rig.enable()
        with rig.service._store(rig.key) as store:
            lease = BindingLifetime.acquire(store.db_path.parent.parent / rig.key.lifetime_name)
            try:
                with rig.fence(rig.key) as live:
                    claim = store.claim_job(status.scope, owner_token="native-v1:" + rig.key.binding_namespace + ":cache-only", authority_revision=live.authority_revision, expected_job_revision=status.job_revision)
                def publish(page):
                    nonlocal prepare_seconds, commit_seconds
                    start = time.perf_counter()
                    prepared = prepare_scan_page(page)
                    prepare_seconds += time.perf_counter() - start
                    start = time.perf_counter()
                    with rig.fence(rig.key) as live:
                        assert store.commit_scan_page(status.scope, claim.job_id, prepared, expected_job_revision=claim.job_revision, authority_revision=live.authority_revision)
                    commit_seconds += time.perf_counter() - start
                publish(ScanPage("", rig.key.root_identity_fingerprint, tuple(ScanEntry(f"g{g:03}", "directory", f"dir-{g}", 0, 0) for g in range(100)), (), True, 1))
                for group in range(100):
                    captures = []
                    for i in range(group, 20000, 100):
                        text = f"generated project keyword {i}\n"
                        data = text.encode("utf-8")
                        captures.append(FileCapture(f"g{group:03}/{i:06}.txt", f"logical-{i}", 0, len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), text))
                    entries = tuple(ScanEntry(c.relative_path, "file", c.identity, c.mtime_ns, c.size_bytes) for c in captures)
                    publish(ScanPage(f"g{group:03}", f"dir-{group}", entries, tuple(captures), True, 1))
                with rig.fence(rig.key):
                    assert store.retire_job(status.scope, claim.job_id, owner_token=claim.owner_token, expected_job_revision=claim.job_revision, state="Ready")
                status = store.load_status(rig.key)
                assert status.indexed == 20000 and status.discovered == 20100
                build_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
                auth = ProjectIndexSearchAuthority(status.scope, rig.live.root, rig.live.chain, (), 1, lambda: rig.read(rig.key) == rig.live, None, lambda candidate: None)
                report = {"qualification": "idle cache-only logical reconstruction; no folder scan/live validation", "platform": platform.platform(), "python": platform.python_version(), "files": status.indexed, "directories_including_root": 101, "prepared_pages": 101, "build_seconds": build_seconds, "prepare_seconds": prepare_seconds, "commit_seconds": commit_seconds, "lexical": {}}
                for label, query, expected in [("common", "generated project keyword", 100), ("rare", "19999", 1), ("miss", "absentkwlookup", 0)]:
                    values = []
                    for i in range(55):
                        start = time.perf_counter()
                        with rig.fence(rig.key):
                            result = store.lexical_candidates(auth, query, limit=100)
                        elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
                        assert len(result) == expected
                        if i >= 5:
                            values.append(elapsed)
                    report["lexical"][label] = {"query": query, "warmups": 5, "n": 50, "limit": 100, "returned": expected, "p50_ms": statistics.median(values), "p95_ms": sorted(values)[47], "samples_ms": values}
                (artifact / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
                print("K4_IDLE_PROFILE=" + json.dumps({**report, "lexical": {k: {field: value for field, value in row.items() if field != "samples_ms"} for k, row in report["lexical"].items()}}), flush=True)
                if any(row["p95_ms"] > 500 for row in report["lexical"].values()):
                    import cProfile, pstats
                    profiler = cProfile.Profile()
                    with profiler:
                        for query in ("generated project keyword", "19999", "absentkwlookup"):
                            with rig.fence(rig.key):
                                store.lexical_candidates(auth, query, limit=100)
                    with (artifact / "phase-profile.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
                        pstats.Stats(profiler, stream=output).sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(40)
                assert all(row["p95_ms"] <= 500 for row in report["lexical"].values())
            finally:
                store.close_native()
                lease.close()
    finally:
        await rig.close()

    try:
        for group in range(100):
            (rig.root / f"g{group:03}").mkdir()
        for i in range(20000):
            (rig.root / f"g{i % 100:03}" / f"{i:06}.txt").write_text(
                f"generated project keyword {i}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        rig.enable()
        rig.refresh()
        status = rig.settle(seconds=600)
        assert status.indexed == 20000
        scanner = ProjectScanner()
        live_times = []
        def read(candidate):
            start = time.perf_counter()
            result = scanner.capture_file(rig.live, candidate.relative_path, stop=threading.Event())
            live_times.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
            return result
        auth = ProjectIndexSearchAuthority(status.scope, rig.live.root, rig.live.chain, (), 1, lambda: True, None, read)
        query_times = []
        with rig.service._store(rig.key) as store:
            for i in range(55):
                start = time.perf_counter()
                candidates = store.lexical_candidates(auth, "generated project keyword", limit=100)
                elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
                assert len(candidates) == 100
                if i >= 5: query_times.append(elapsed)
        start = time.perf_counter()
        result = rig.service.search(auth, "generated project keyword", limit=10)
        total_live = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
        assert len(result.hits) == 10
        def summary(values):
            return {"n": len(values), "p50_ms": statistics.median(values), "p95_ms": sorted(values)[int(0.95 * (len(values) - 1))]}
        report = {"platform": platform.platform(), "python": platform.python_version(), "cpus": os.cpu_count(),
                  "files": 20000, "directories": 100, "lexical": summary(query_times),
                  "capture": summary(live_times), "live_service_10_hits_ms": total_live,
                  "scanner_retired": scanner.retired, "pipes_closed": scanner.pipes_closed,
                  "max_active_reads": scanner.max_active_reads, "max_queued_bytes": scanner.max_queued_text_bytes}
        print("K4_PROFILE=" + json.dumps(report), flush=True)
        assert report["lexical"]["p95_ms"] <= 500
    finally:
        await rig.close()
